ValidationRule.description: This rule will prevent the stages of Statements In - Approval being selected on Concurrent Deals.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordTypeId = "01280000000BZwl", ISPICKVAL(Type,"CONCURRENT"), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Statements In - MCA"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Pre-Qual MCA"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Approved - MCA")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Concurrent deal does not need to be submitted to operations for approval. If you are ready to send docs out, please change the Stage to Offer In.
